lines: DM: Okay, so as Kenzo soothes and talks to the Heartroot, it begins to… it begins to curl up within itself, pulling itself tight, extracting its roots, drawing them in. [garbled]

interactions.title: Kenzo’s bond and the spear’s limits
lines: Kenzo: By the way, now that I'm bonded to the Heartroot, just so everybody knows, if I get damaged and fucked up, the Heartroot does too, so…
Wellby: So if she puts her spear in you, goes in the Heartroot?
Kenzo: That's actually an interesting question.
DM: No, you can't corrupt the Heartroot by spearing Kenzo.
DM: If the Heartroot gets corrupted, then Kenzo might also be corrupted.
Kenzo: No, but also, I think it's two-way though, right, Tim? Like, if I die.
DM: It is… it is two-way. If Kenzo dies, it might be pretty bad for the Heartroot.

before: DM: Boom.
Seeker: Yeah, I can go, like, here.
DM: Triceratops. Is okay, just waiting.
Wellby: No, the Triceratops, sniffs the air and stomps the ground and shakes his head back and forth, moving to put himself between all of us and the approaching storm.
DM: Let me send you the stat block for the Triceratops, by the way.
after: Kenzo: Just sayin'. I'm normally…

Kenzo: I'll be down to die. This time might be a little bit boring.

Kenzo: I die all the time, it's kind of my thing.

interactions.title: What Kenzo’s death would mean for the Heartroot
lines: Kenzo: And then, just, Kenzo's just, like, feeling it out. Like, if he dies, like, what happens to the Heartroot? Like, how bad's it gonna be for the Heartroot?

DM: Kong… like, falls unconscious or dies, dies. If you fall unconscious… it's probably okay. If you are, like, literally killed by the Chaos Spear… It's probably not quite as bad as the… actual corruption, but it's not gonna be good.
DM: But, I mean, you can tell, if she knocks you unconscious, she's not, like, going to attack somebody else. She's going to kill you.

DM: Hmm, that's true.
Delwath: Kenzo, how far away is Kenzo from me? I mean, how far away is Kenzo?

interactions.title: The Empress dies; the Cataclysm is destroyed
lines: DM: And she… she hasn't spoken, she's been, like, angry and just kind of fighting the whole time. She hasn't acknowledged your presence. But as this last blow hits her, the armor begins to shimmer. And she looks, and she says, "You fool! You have no idea what you've done! Chaos will have victory one way or another." And as she dies, the armor begins to expand…
DM: and expand, and expand into a swirling mass of formless metal.

DM: Yeah, it's like her body is being ripped to shreds as the armor expands out and out and out into this sort of 20-foot-sized… whirlwind with, like, bits of a face beginning to form out of the metal, and you can actually hear her horrifying shriek as she is consumed by the chaos energy of Limbo.
Kenzo: ((Transformation)) And Kenzo has now turned himself into a giant silver dragon.
DM: It pounces on the swirling mass of metal, and you just take your claws and you, like, rip it apart.

DM: And it begins to shatter and… drift apart, and then you slowly… with your giant wings… land protectively on top of the… Heartroot and bring your wings over on top as the stone begins to… like, ash and metal begins to fall, just standing there guarding the top of the Heartroot.

before: Kenzo: Can you smite now?

DM: Roll your damage first before you smite.
Delwath: Okay. If she's that close to dead. 1d8 plus 11… 14… Plus 5 Radiant.
DM: So, as your sword strikes her, the armor begins to swarm around her, and, like, swarm… she looks at you.

DM: That's like…

interactions.title: The dragon turns the main battle
lines: DM: ((Blessing)) you gather on the back of the silver dragon Kenzo and fly… the short distance to the battle still raging. At the moment… the Hobgoblins seem to have… solidified their position and established a solid defensive line, having driven many of the hippos off. And the rangers are beginning to fall back when… a dragon just flies right through the illusory mountain, and… immediately swoops down on the Hobgoblin troops with a… massive line of cold that rips through their defenses and… breaks a hole in the front of the line, as the Rangers and lizardfolk and Aurbezi militias and… folks still remaining as… as hippos, and Vindristjarna, where… Faldrak, despite taking some damage, has managed to defeat the metallic birds that you left. With great help from Hektor and a few others. ((Experience aside))

DM: You plunge down, and… on the back of the dragon with Wellby's arrows, ((Seeker’s resources)) But the Ladder part, of course, also lasts for an hour. A little bit annoyed at being upstaged by a dragon, and so is really trying his best to, like, kill as many hobgoblins as it can.
DM: Over the course of the next half an hour or so, you rout the Hobgoblin troops. Tide of battle being… dramatically turned by the arrival of… a Silver Dragon.
